map_validation: All 63 maps and source dependencies are byte-identical to the previously validated stable release.
changes: Rupture Warhead: epic, up to 2 additional targets, 50% damage each.
Combat Morph: fully restore allied Zerg troop health within 5 tiles after Lurker, Guardian or Devourer morph completion.
Phase Echo: standalone Protoss epic; successful spell cast restores 20% maximum shields to allied Protoss troops within 5 tiles, once per recipient per 5 seconds.
limitations: Synthetic native host, UI, protocol and disposable database validation; live combat balance and appearance remain unverified.
